t59h_p9d: You post something in the group chat and nobody answers, so you're checking it every five minutes all evening. I think this is where the Guide points you to a kind of belonging that doesn't cost you yourself. For some people that's nature, or just being alive at all. For others it's what their tradition calls ultimate, God, say, or the Tao. It gets a lot more solid than an idea once you've spent real time outside, and prayer or meditation does it too. With that underneath you, a quiet group chat stops feeling like the end of the world.
t59h_p10c: I've been calling this part the Guide, but call it whatever works for you. Plenty of people would go with "Guru," and plenty who got out of a cult would rather never hear that word again, which is fair enough. The Wise One works, or your inner teacher. Whatever the name, it points past itself, and past whoever happens to be approving of you this week, so your little one doesn't take that for the deepest belonging there is.
